SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TIMESEQ, SEQ, COMPANY_CODE, SYS_CODE FROM PLDELIVDMROT_KEP WHERE LEGJOBFLAG = '400' ORDER BY TIMESEQ, SEQ, COMPANY_CODE, SYS_CODE
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT COMPANY_CODE, SYS_CODE, DELIV_NO AS INV_NO, DELIV_SEQ AS INV_SEQ, PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, DELIV_NO AS LEGACY_IV_SERIAL FROM PLDELIVDMROT_KEP WHERE TIMESEQ = '$G_RS.TIMESEQ$' AND SEQ = '$G_RS.SEQ$' AND COMPANY_CODE = '$G_RS.COMPANY_CODE$' AND SYS_CODE = '$G_RS.SYS_CODE$'
UPDATE PLDELIVDMROT_KEP SET LEGJOBFLAG = '500' WHERE TIMESEQ = '$G_RS.TIMESEQ$' AND SEQ = '$G_RS.SEQ$' AND COMPANY_CODE = '$G_RS.COMPANY_CODE$' AND SYS_CODE = '$G_RS.SYS_CODE$'
